name: tool_search
description: Discover enabled tools for the user's actual goal via compact summaries. Describe the needed capability and result fields, such as 'flight status arrival delay terminal gate' or 'movie streaming providers', rather than a generic 'web search'. Use limit=6 (the default) to compare relevant capabilities; limit=1 is for inspecting one already-known exact name with tool_names. Omit full schemas by default (leave include_schema false) unless you need exact parameter shapes. After matches return, call the surfaced tools by exact name; do not loop on tool_search alone.

query.description: Describe the actual goal, entity and required result fields, e.g. 'flight status arrival delay terminal gate' or 'movie streaming providers'. A generic query such as 'web search' can hide tools with richer results. Leave empty to browse; use tool_names to inspect an already-known exact tool.

limit.description: Maximum number of matching tools to return. Use the default 6 for capability discovery so several suitable options can be compared (server cap 20). Use 1 only with tool_names to inspect one already-known exact tool.

tool_names.description: Optional exact tool names to inspect directly instead of doing semantic search.

include_schema.description: Defaults to false (recommended). Only set true when you must read exact parameter keys/types; each schema adds substantial context.
